label: Mod loader
unsupportedHint: This loader has no build for this game version
fabricApi: Also install Fabric API (required by most Fabric mods)

fabricApiFailed.title: Fabric API was not installed
fabricApiFailed.content: The mod loader for "{name}" is installed, but Fabric API failed to install: {error}. Most Fabric mods need it, so search for "Fabric API" on the instance's resource page to install it again.

bmclapi: {name} versions and files are mirrored by BMCLAPI (bangbang93, bmclapidoc.bangbang93.com), falling back to the official source on failure.

change.title: Change mod loader of "{name}"
change.warning: This modifies the instance: installed mods may not work with the new loader, so consider exporting a backup first. The install runs in the task center and takes effect when it finishes.
change.started: Installing the mod loader for "{name}". Track progress in the task center.
